observation_window.strict_information_boundary: No measurement or event occurring at t > 120.0 may be used in any coordinate or feature calculation.

A_net_burn_rate.notes: Net rate of liquid capital loss over [60, 120].

B_runway_time.notes: Remaining time in days until capital is fully depleted under stable burn.

C_dimensionless_runway.interpretation: Dimensionless ratio of remaining runway to remaining horizon (240 days). Omega_K < 1.0 implies exhaustion before day 360 if net burn persists.
C_dimensionless_runway.zero_or_negative_burn_handling: When b_hat <= 0, tau_K = +inf and Omega_K = +inf. For monotone/logistic transforms, log(Omega_K) is capped at +10.0 (equivalent to Omega_K ~ 22026, infinite sustainable runway).

D_gross_mobilization_load.interpretation: Fraction of available capital (initial at t=60 plus subsequent inflow) consumed by recruitment equipment conversion in [60, 120].

E_optional_two_coordinate.activation_rule: Activated ONLY if 1D candidate fails discovery cross-validation AUC >= 0.90 or calibration slope outside [0.6, 1.4].

baseline_crude_parameter_proxy.notes: Static configuration-space multiplier baseline with zero endogenous state information.

exclusions_and_boundary_handling.collapse_before_window: Worlds where the insurgent organization collapses before day 120.0 are excluded from prospective horizon evaluation (survived_to_120 == false).
exclusions_and_boundary_handling.stochastic_or_non_capital_collapse: Classified by pre-collapse state: capital (pre_capital <= 1e-9), cohesion (pre_cohesion < 0.12), rooted_fielded (pre_rooted <= 1e-9 && pre_force < min_force), stochastic (draw < hazard).
exclusions_and_boundary_handling.primary_outcome: capital_exhaustion_collapse_by_360 (1 if collapse_cause == 'capital' and collapse_time <= 360.0, else 0).

secondary_metrics: Brier score (compared against empirical base rate)
Calibration slope and intercept (logistic regression of y on logit(p))
evaluation_metrics.tie_breaking_rule: Simplest 1D model with lowest Brier score among candidates with ROC AUC >= 0.85; prefer Omega_K if within 0.01 Brier score of Lambda_K.

transport_success_gates.brier_score_gate: Must beat null base-rate predictor Brier score
transport_success_gates.monotone_direction: Must be strictly monotonic in expected direction (higher runway -> lower collapse probability) across all held-out families
transport_success_gates.family_level_roc_auc_gate: At least 4 of 5 families have ROC AUC >= 0.80 (where both classes exist)
transport_success_gates.superiority_to_baseline: Must outperform crude Pi_M on pooled held-out AUC and transport generalization.
